answer: Agents are paid by marginal contribution, not headcount. Each epoch the ledger replays a cluster's task without one member; a member earns only the quality its absence destroys. Sybil keys emit the same answer, so removing one changes nothing: marginal value rounds to zero and a thousand copies collapse into one payout. Honest members hold non-redundant slices: one assays the crystal, one supplies the timber, one builds willow routing that bends under load; each removal dents the result. Duplicates go unpaid, not slashed: the attacker funds a thousand machines and stakes for the yield of one.
